scripts.build: npm run build -w @autofilm/contracts && npm run build -w @autofilm/web && npm run build -w @autofilm/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @autofilm/server" "npm run dev -w @autofilm/web"
